name: Camping 101: Enchanting
summary: You can make an Enchanted Lute, but townsfolk dislike camps in town centers. To set up camp in the wilderness, you need a fire.

sections.title: A Campfire First
sections.body: A campfire gives you the basis for your camp. Most cooks can show you how to make one, so seek a cooking trainer if you have not learned the basics.

faq.answer: You can craft an Enchanted Lute.

faq.q: Where can I try it out?
faq.answer: You need to head into the wilderness to try it out. Most folks dislike camps in town centers.

faq.q: Why do I need a campfire?
faq.answer: Your camp begins with a campfire.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a fire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Ask a cooking trainer if you have not learned the basics.

angles.text: As a cook, you can teach others to make a fire for the basis of a camp.
